newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Sweden Nov producer prices seen unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Sweden Nov producer prices seen unchanged.

text.p: Swedish producer prices are expected to be unchanged for November which will give a fall of 3.4 percent for the 12 months to date, a Reuters poll of 16 analysts found on Friday.
The forecasts ranged between a fall of 0.3 percent and a rise of 0.5 percent for the month, giving yearly figures ranging from a fall of 2.8 percent to a fall of 3.8 percent.
In October producer prices fell 0.1 percent for a year fall of 4.3 percent.
In November 1995 producer prices fell 1.0 percent for a yearly rise of 7.1 percent.
Sweden's official statistics bureau SCB will release the November producer price figure on December 20 at 0900 GMT.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Aragon, Carnegie, Chase, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, J P Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Nomura Bank, PaineWebber, Salomon Brothers, Sparbanken, Transferator and Union Bank of Switzerland.
